name: Iguchi Youko
source:
"If that person comes, I'll pass."

She does not like the fact that Erena has become Haruka's "Esu" and treats her harshly.

On the other hand, she is honest with herself and is the first to give compliments to Haruka, whom she respects.

[Translated from [url=https://www.otomate.jp/chouchoujiken/chara/index7.php]official website[/url]]
